item: The apply path writes its rows through Core statements (row 418)
summary: Date tags, places, entities, the article's derived columns and the stamp upserts leave the ORM unit of work with identical rows and ids (tests/test_apply_core_row418.py keeps the ORM code as reference); the SQLite ON CONFLICT upserts are compiled once because SQLAlchemy cannot cache them; single-writer time 13.1 to 8.6 ms per article on 2 cores; golden output unchanged, engine pins re-recorded with --same
